# 1iQ

> 1iQ is a development intelligence platform for real estate developers, investors, family offices and the contractors who build for them. It reads a construction schedule, checks it, and then tracks planned progress against what really happens on site, so everyone knows where a project stands the moment it changes.

1iQ was founded by Chimi Kadiya, a construction program and project manager with more than 15 years of experience. The company is 1iQ LLC.

## What 1iQ does

- Construction schedule review: reads Primavera P6 (.xer, .xml), Microsoft Project XML and Excel schedules, recalculates the critical path and runs the DCMA 14 point schedule assessment plus logic checks.
- Tracking: keeps three dates side by side. The original plan is fixed once agreed. The working schedule moves only with a project manager's approval. The forecast is worked out from what has really happened.
- Decisions: shows a project manager what needs a decision now, such as holds, sign offs and fixed issues.
- Reporting: owner and investor reports written from live project data, with past reports kept.
- Feasibility: execution risk and schedule projections before a project starts.

## Pages

- [Construction schedule review](https://www.1iq.ai/construction-schedule-review/): how developers and owners test a contractor's schedule before signing, with a free schedule scorecard
- [Preconstruction scheduling](https://www.1iq.ai/preconstruction-scheduling/): how contractors check a bid schedule before submitting it, with the same scorecard
- [Platform](https://www.1iq.ai/platform/): the four parts of 1iQ (Core, Field, Intel, Gantt) and how it connects to existing tools
- [For developers](https://www.1iq.ai/developer/): feasibility, live oversight and investor reporting, with an exposure estimate
- [Book a briefing](https://www.1iq.ai/schedule/): a private 30 minute briefing

## Facts

- Pricing is not published. It is discussed in a briefing.
- The free scorecard shows a score out of 100, the number of quality checks passed and the three biggest problems by name. The uploaded file is not kept.
- 1iQ does not judge a contractor's durations. It checks whether the schedule can be tracked truthfully.
- Contact: admin@1iq.ai
